title: [29.X]-Dispute Status – Inconsistent On Hold and Document Synchronization on Vendor Ledger Entries.
summary: Fixes inconsistent On Hold and document synchronization behaviour tied to the dispute status on vendor ledger entries, with related changes to customer ledger entries, in the 29.x release across W1 and localized layers.
key_points: Addresses inconsistent On Hold and document synchronization tied to dispute status on vendor ledger entries
Vendor Ledger Entry and Cust. Ledger Entry tables changed in W1 and several localized layers
Tests added to EditPostedDocuments in W1 and several localizations
